coin.title: Malta 10 Euro 2022 ‘The Lord of the Rings’ Silver Prooflike PL68
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=P5DFE3I]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Adding a top quality Silver coin to your collection? PL68 coins offer a radiant mirror finish with only tiny imperfections. This Malta 10 euro 2022 “Lord of the Rings” Silver Prooflike is truly eye-catching and will stand out in any collection, not in the least because of the color detail. This coin is a fine example of premium prooflike quality. Design The obverse of the coin shows, in the middle, the White tree of Gondor, the symbol of the continent Gondor, which brought luck, according to the inhabitants. The tree has a color detail. Around the tree is the famous text that is also on the ring. The text says: ‘One Ring to rule them all, one Ring to find them, one Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them’. The upper letters are embossed, the bottom letters are a gold color. On the reverse is the logo of the Central Bank of Malta, the privy mark and the year of issue.
